text:
maria: heads-up — saw a weird duplication pattern in onboarding sampleapp when a 429 hits at the same time as token rotation. user-facing action executed twice. repro attached.

alex: ugh. can you paste the minimal repro? thinking jitter + immediate retry after refresh might be the culprit.

maria: repro steps: 1) start sampleapp request that triggers server-side rate limiting (429). 2) token refresh happens concurrently on auth thread. 3) SDK retry kicks in with jitter but we didn't attach an idempotency key in the tutorial code. result: duplicate webhook / duplicate DB write.

jordan: that matches a hit we saw in staging last week. logs show: `POST /v1/action 429 -> SDK refresh token -> retry no-idempotency -> 200` then side-effect executed.

chen: quick snippet from sampleapp (current):
```js
// simplified client call in sampleapp
await client.createTask({ body }); // no idempotency header in tutorial
```

chen: suggested fix for sampleapp: show `Idempotency-Key` header + small helper that returns a deterministic UUID per user action.

sam: agree. also update SDK docs to recommend: 1) attach idempotency key for non-idempotent endpoints, 2) use exponential backoff with capped jitter, 3) treat 429 as potentially safe-replay only if server signals `Retry-After` or we have idempotency.

maria: for onboarding friction, we should keep the sample concise but safe. propose we change the quickstart snippet to this minimal pattern:
```js
const id = makeRequestId(userId, payload);
await client.createTask({ body }, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id } });
```

alex: +1. Also add a checkbox in the quickstart that says "does this request cause side effects?" to nudge users.

jordan: operationally, we should add an e2e test that simulates: 429 + auth rotation + retry. CI harness can replay the race deterministically (small sleep windows).

maria: filing a tiny PR checklist in the sampleapp repo. linking draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/1234 (WIP).

ops-bot: Deployed test VM cluster for repro at staging-replay-42 — logs pushed to /staging/logs/replay-42.

sam: for SDK behavior, we may want a default safe-replay window + an opt-in strict mode that refuses to replay non-idempotent calls after auth refresh. that gives DX-friendly defaults but lets platform teams harden.

chen: SDK API idea: `client.request(..., { idempotencyKey?: string, allowRefreshReplay?: boolean = true })` and we document that `allowRefreshReplay=false` will surface an error instead of automatically retrying when a token rotation occurred.

alex: UX note — keep quickstart code tiny and link to a "Production Hardening" page explaining the flags and patterns.

maria: action items: @alex update quickstart snippet + checkbox; @chen add idempotency example + API proposal; @jordan add CI e2e repro; @sam write SDK semantics doc for `allowRefreshReplay`; i'll land the PR with wording changes and reference to ops test VM. target: end of week. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll own the e2e test. tagging QA for a run after PR merges.

alex: I'll do copy + sample commit. will ping when ready.

maria: thanks all — saved one unhappy customer. :)
